movie_updates.title: Anaconda
movie_updates.description: Anaconda is a comedy about two friends' (Paul Rudd, Jack Black) attempt to remake the 1997 cult classic, only to face attacks by a real giant anaconda. In addition to humans being snatched or devoured by giant snakes, the action includes gun threats, shootings, head-butting, a snake getting torn to pieces by a propellor, characters being knocked out, a wounded face slammed up against a window, and more. A character who's thought to be dead is used as a distraction, with a dead boar duct-taped to his head and a dead squirrel inserted into his mouth. movie_updates.title: The Great Flood
movie_updates.description: A mother wakes up in her apartment to her 5-year-old boy exclaiming that there's water everywhere outside. Before she knows it, the water level of her entire apartment complex is rising, and she and her son must fight to get to the roof before they are washed away. There's some gun violence, shootouts, and fighting. Characters get shot in the chest and head (impacts not shown) and die. Characters fight, wrestle, punch, kick, throw, hit, and choke other characters. A character strangles another character to death. A character is dragged by her hair. A character throws two people out of a high story window after breaking their arms. Many people get caught in huge flooding, struggle to swim, and drown. Dead bodies float along the water's surface and underwater. Huge waves crash into and through buildings and windows, taking people along, many dying in the process. A 5-year-old boy is handcuffed to a railing. People also shave the boy's head and take a circular saw to the boy's scalp (not shown).
